title: Receiving two results
hints: A function with more than one result lists the result types in parentheses: func f() (int, string).
A call that returns two values has to be assigned to two variables. If you only need one of them, put the blank identifier _ in place of the other.
func DivMod(a, b int) (int, int) { … } and, in Quotient, q, _ := DivMod(a, b).
